item.title: Can someone explain the entirety of the Scarlet King lore?: Re: Can someone explain the entirety of the Scarlet King lore?
item.content:encoded:
Mostly (I think it was) Djorc didn’t like the implications of what Montauk is, which were more sexual originally before Clef toned it down some, so he made the whale thing to provide a less horrible alternative.

Other five-digit species include “camel”, “llama”, “horse”, “angel”, “demon”, “Yeren”
(SCP-1000), and my personal favorite, “shark”, in which case 110-Montauk is definitely punching.

But yeah, she’s totally a human.

item.title: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is): Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: Given the extremely negative responses to recent attempts to write up the COVID pandemic as an anomaly, it's probably not a good idea to encourage people do so. Members of the SCP wiki community have lost loved ones to coronavirus; attributing that very real life tragedy to a fictionalized anomalous version can come off as incredibly tactless.

item.title: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?: Re: Information on the IS and IS NOT entity from SCP-4840?
item.content:encoded:
Looking through the backlinks (accessible from "+ Options" at the bottom), the only tale linking to it seems to be this one. It's possible there are other articles that either don't link to 4840 within their body, or do so in an unsupported way, however.

I haven't read 4840 myself, but it seems like it's a capstone piece for djkaktus' little mythos and various other site fixtures. The entities seem to be new, however.
